title: Add an organization-wide email address
when: The step asks to register a new organization-wide 'From' address (a display name and an email address, usable by all profiles or by named ones). It is not email deliverability, not an email relay, and not a user's own email address. Verifying the address needs someone to click a link in an email, which is outside this procedure.
steps: In the embedded Organization-Wide Email Addresses page, click 'Add'.
Type the display name and the email address the step gives.
Choose 'Allow All Profiles to Use this From Address', unless the step names specific profiles.
doneWhen: The Organization-Wide Email Addresses list shows the new display name and address, pending verification.

verified.outcome: Trial step matched at p=1.00; 5 actions, 34 s, reviewer confirmed; a fresh session showed the address with status 'Verification Request Sent'. Confirmed without any model: SOQL on OrgWideEmailAddress returned 'Release Bot <autopilot-trial@example.com>'. The address stays unusable until a person clicks the emailed link.

trial.step: Add an organization-wide email address with display name Release Bot and address autopilot-trial@example.com, available to all profiles.

notes: Salesforce emails a verification link to the address. Until a person clicks it the address cannot be used.
